reviews.comment: Dr. Sarkar is a professor who clearly knows her subject well. I really enjoyed her class. Wanna succeed. Show up and participate, she makes an effort to get to know her students and genuinely wants them to do well. She provides plenty of support, along with very easy homework and extra credit opportunities that can help boost your grade.

Dr. Sarkar is truly one of the best professors I've ever had. She has a remarkable depth of knowledge in this field and a genuine passion for teaching that shines through in every lecture. She is very caring and approachable. highly recommend it to any student looking for a meaningful and enriching learning experience.

She is a decent teacher with easy tests and assignments. However, she gets frustrated with the students for no reason. She will ask if there are any questions and then seem annoyed by the questions. Or get mad when the students don't remember something from weeks prior. She scolded me in front of the entire class bc I didn't do an extra credit.

Dr. Sarkar was an easy prof. She details exactly what you need to know for exams (which are not hard). The exam review lectures were especially helpful as she outlined stuff that will be tested. Great class, easy A.

Charismatic and entertaining lecturer. Manages to remember your name and face regardless of how often you show up to lecture - and will call you out for skipping class. Keeps students engaged and accountable. Very fun and useful course taught by an extremely knowledgable and engaging lecturer.
Super awesome prof! Just attend all lectures and do your assignments on time!

Super easy if you attend lecture. She will call people out at random to answer questions so be prepared. Exams are what she said will be on them. She goes over everything in very clear details and makes sure the class knows it. Only two super easy HWs, 4 exams and thats it. If she says to download something download it! Solid professor!
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Very good teacher! She was kind and tested mainly on information provided in class. The exams were straight forward and she gives good feedback in office hours. Excellent at explaining the concepts in class.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Beware of pop quizzes--Caring
